title: 1. General Terms
description: This agreement is between Migga Scooter Rental (Owner) and the individual named on the rental form (Renter). By confirming a booking, signing electronically, or taking possession of the scooter, the Renter agrees to comply with all terms and conditions. The scooter remains the property of Migga Scooter Rental throughout the rental period.

title: 2. Rental Eligibility
description: The Renter must be at least 18 years old and possess a valid Sri Lankan or International Driving License permitting motorcycle or scooter operation. A passport or government-issued identification document must be provided for verification purposes.

title: 3. Payment Policy
description: Full rental payment must be completed before collecting the scooter. Payments may be made in cash or electronically in Sri Lankan Rupees (LKR). A security deposit may be required depending on the scooter type, rental duration, or risk assessment. Early returns are permitted but unused rental days are non-refundable.

title: 4. Rental Period
description: The rental period begins and ends according to the dates and times stated in the booking. Late returns may incur additional charges. Rental extensions must be approved before the scheduled return time.

title: 5. Fuel Policy
description: The scooter will be provided with a specified fuel level and must be returned with the same fuel level. Fuel shortages may result in refueling charges.

title: 6. Scooter Use
description: The scooter is intended solely for personal transportation on public roads. It must not be used for racing, towing, off-road riding, delivery services, commercial activities, unlawful purposes, or any activity prohibited by Sri Lankan law. The Renter must wear a helmet and obey all traffic regulations.

title: 7. Restricted Areas and Protected Locations
description: The scooter must not be ridden inside national parks, wildlife reserves, forest reserves, eco parks, archaeological protected areas, safari tracks, jungle routes, restricted government lands, or any location where motorcycles or scooters are prohibited. For wildlife parks and jungle safaris, authorized safari jeeps or approved transportation services must be used instead.

title: 8. Government Authorities and Legal Responsibility
description: Migga Scooter Rental bears no responsibility for fines, arrests, legal proceedings, vehicle impoundment, penalties, or damages resulting from violations involving the Department of Wildlife Conservation, Forest Department, Department of Archaeology, Police, Local Authorities, or any government institution. The Renter is solely responsible for complying with all regulations and restrictions.

title: 9. Violation Assistance Charges
description: If Migga Scooter Rental or its representatives are required to travel, attend police stations, courts, government offices, wildlife offices, forest offices, archaeological offices, impound yards, or other locations due to incidents, violations, investigations, accidents, or legal matters caused by the Renter, the Renter agrees to pay all transportation expenses, administrative costs, loss-of-time charges, and related costs incurred by Migga Scooter Rental.

title: 10. Damage, Theft and Loss
description: The Renter is fully responsible for any damage, theft, loss, confiscation, or destruction of the scooter during the rental period. The Renter must immediately inform Migga Scooter Rental of any accident, damage, theft, or incident. Repair costs, replacement costs, towing costs, and associated expenses are the responsibility of the Renter.

title: 11. Helmet and Accessories
description: Any helmet, key, lock, or accessory supplied with the scooter remains the property of Migga Scooter Rental. Lost or damaged helmets will incur a replacement fee of 6,000 LKR per helmet. Lost keys or damaged locks may incur replacement charges.

title: 12. Traffic Violations
description: The Renter is solely responsible for all traffic violations, fines, parking penalties, speeding offenses, camera violations, and legal consequences arising during the rental period. Any fines received by Migga Scooter Rental relating to the rental period may be charged directly to the Renter.

title: 13. Insurance and Liability
description: Any insurance coverage provided is limited to the extent required by Sri Lankan law. Migga Scooter Rental is not responsible for personal injury, medical expenses, property damage, loss of belongings, lost income, or other costs arising from the Renter's use of the scooter.

title: 14. Maintenance and Mechanical Issues
description: All scooters are maintained in good working condition. The Renter must inspect the scooter before use and report any issues immediately. Unauthorized repairs are not permitted without prior approval from Migga Scooter Rental.

title: 15. Return Policy
description: The scooter must be returned on the agreed date, time, and location. Early returns do not qualify for refunds. Additional rental days must be requested in advance and approved by Migga Scooter Rental.

title: 16. Termination of Rental
description: Migga Scooter Rental may immediately terminate the rental agreement and recover the scooter if the Renter violates these terms, provides false information, misuses the scooter, enters prohibited areas, commits unlawful acts, or causes intentional damage.

title: 17. Governing Law
description: This agreement shall be governed by and interpreted according to the laws of Sri Lanka. Any disputes shall be subject to the jurisdiction of Sri Lankan courts.

title: 18. Electronic Acceptance
description: By checking the agreement box, confirming a booking, making payment, signing electronically, or taking possession of the scooter, the Renter acknowledges that they have read, understood, and accepted all terms and conditions. Electronic acceptance shall have the same legal effect as a handwritten signature.
